evals.prompt: Here's a syslog pattern from an NCS5500: '%PKT_INFRA-FM-3-FAULT_MAJOR : ALARM_MAJOR : Fan Tray 0 : declare : system : max speed to compensate loss of fantrays'. Research folder is at research/fan-tray-ncs5500/. Generate the appropriate intelligence artifacts.
evals.expected_output: Should detect FS + RG candidates from syslog pattern and troubleshooting context. Should generate fault-signature YAML with regex matching the syslog, a remediation guide with diagnosis and repair steps, and offer to generate a RAW. All YAML files should pass schema validation. Output should be in ia-drafts/fan-tray-ncs5500/.

evals.prompt: I have an optimized TSG for a fabric not ready event. The optimized guide is at research/fabric-not-ready/optimized-tsg.md. Convert it into a repair action workflow.
evals.expected_output: Should detect RAW candidate from the optimized TSG input. Should generate a repair-action-workflow YAML with steps derived from the TSG, proper branching, custom_action for physical interventions, and escalation for TAC/RMA exits. Should include a RAW analysis document with Mermaid flowchart. YAML should pass schema validation.

evals.prompt: Create all applicable intelligence artifacts for this optics module reset issue. Source data: Syslog pattern '%OPTICS-1-LOSS_OF_LIGHT : Optics0/0/0/1 - Loss of Light, interface is down' on NCS-55A1-36H-SE-S running IOS-XR 7.11.1. Troubleshooting: 1) Check show controllers optics for DOM values. 2) Check for fiber damage or dirty connectors. 3) Clean connectors and verify light levels. 4) If RX power still below -25dBm after cleaning, check remote end. 5) If both ends clean and light levels bad, replace SFP. 6) If replacement SFP also fails, escalate to TAC for possible linecard issue.
evals.expected_output: Should detect FS + RG + RAW as a linked set from the syslog pattern and multi-step troubleshooting procedure. Should generate all three with aligned IDs (e.g., FS000004/RG000004/RAW000004). FS should have regex for LOSS_OF_LIGHT syslog with interface extraction. RG should have D1-D4 diagnosis steps and R1-R3 repair steps. RAW should use custom_action for 'clean connectors' and 'replace SFP', escalate only for TAC. All YAMLs should pass validation. Should include OPEN DESIGN QUESTIONS block in each.
